gloss: previous generation; former era; predecessor's reign

definitions.gloss: previous generation; former era; earlier times
definitions.explanation: Refers to the generation, era, or period that came before the present one. Most commonly encountered in the four-character compound 前代未聞 (unprecedented).

examples.japanese: ⟦{前代未聞|ぜんだいみもん}→前代未聞：05949_zendaimimon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧だ。
{前代|ぜんだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{築|きず}いた→築く：02046_kizuku⟧⟦{基盤|きばん}→基盤：00220_kiban⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{継|つ}いだ→引き継ぐ：12458_hikitsugu⟧。
examples.english: He inherited the foundation built by the previous president.

examples.japanese: {前代|ぜんだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}する→更新する：27994_koushinsuru⟧⟦{前代未聞|ぜんだいみもん}→前代未聞：05949_zendaimimon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{快挙|かいきょ}→快挙：12579_kaikyo⟧だった。
examples.english: It was an unprecedented feat that smashed the previous era's record by a wide margin.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{前|ぜん}→前〜：03957_zen⟧ (previous) + ⟦{代|だい}→〜代：28331_dai⟧ (generation, era). While it can refer to a preceding generation or era in a general sense, in modern Japanese it appears overwhelmingly in the fixed expression ⟦{前代未聞|ぜんだいみもん}→前代未聞：05949_zendaimimon⟧ (literally 'unheard of in previous generations'), meaning unprecedented or unheard of.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{前代未聞|ぜんだいみもん}→前代未聞：05949_zendaimimon⟧: unprecedented; unheard of (by far the most common usage)
- {前代|ぜんだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧: record from the previous era
- {前代|ぜんだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{王|おう}→王：19353_ou⟧: the previous king

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{先代|せんだい}→先代：14793_sendai⟧: predecessor — specifically the person who held a position before the current holder (family head, shop owner, etc.)
- ⟦{前任|ぜんにん}→前任：20113_zennin⟧: predecessor in office — focuses on the role/position rather than the era
- ⟦{旧来|きゅうらい}→旧来：13155_kyuurai⟧: traditional, from the past — describes things that have continued from earlier times
